parameters.name: period_mode
parameters.description: Required. Period comparison model: yoy | qoq | mom | custom

parameters.name: growth_basis
parameters.description: Optional. Growth ranking basis: spend | sales | profit | margin (default: sales)

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Required when period_mode=custom. Start date in YYYY-MM-DD or m/d/Y format

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Required when period_mode=custom. End date in YYYY-MM-DD or m/d/Y format, on or after date_from

parameters.name: min_volume
parameters.description: Optional. Minimum purchase volume before a supplier qualifies as a mover (default: 1000)

parameters.name: preview_weights[on_time_delivery]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for on-time delivery; all six preview_weights must be supplied together and sum to 100

parameters.name: preview_weights[lead_time_reliability]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for lead-time reliability

parameters.name: preview_weights[fill_rate]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for fill rate

parameters.name: preview_weights[defect_rate]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for defect rate

parameters.name: preview_weights[cost_competitiveness]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for cost competitiveness

parameters.name: preview_weights[price_stability]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Weight for price stability

parameters.name: preview_thresholds[on_time_delivery][0][min]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Lower bound of a threshold band for on_time_delivery (numeric)

parameters.name: preview_thresholds[on_time_delivery][0][score]
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Score 1-5 for that band

parameters.name: preview_min_po_count
parameters.description: Optional (live preview). Minimum in-period PO count; integer min 1. Required together with preview_weights and preview_thresholds
